scope: ABI 2 Swift host/guest fan-in and build linkage; no runtime, model or VM execution by reviewer
findings: Closed request keys reject teacher/gold fields; case and job bounds, token IDs, distinct zero-placeholder offsets, and strictly earlier source indices are enforced.

Host and guest callback paths use actual previously produced full-vocabulary argmax predictions. The guest alone writes guest feedback slots; Swift checks the actual stopped guest input against each named source prediction.

The model remains evaluation-only original Prime10M geometry with74 F32 tensors and10227968 parameters, verify:.all, finite16384-wide logits and unrestricted lowest-ID argmax. No gold labels or replacement answers enter this source.
Exact policies are Z8 at16/64 and full vocabulary0..<16384. Host and guest stop before a dependent inference on invalid Z8 feedback; full vocabulary admits224 without assigning task-level success.

Guest receipts preserve callback failures and actual cleanup before throwing. Top-level completed describes finishing the bounded collection; case stopped_invalid_feedback is retained and is not model success.
Build validates the ABI 2 source/image/header/object receipt and links retained441 MLXLLM dependency objects plus actual admission. It does not run the model.
limits: JSONDecoder exact-key checks do not independently reject duplicate JSON member names; root-generated requests use unique keys.

Swift inference is synchronous and cannot be interrupted by the guest watchdog. The bridge joins its watchdog after callback return; the existing120-second process owner is still required for a stuck callback.
